summary: Implemented and tested Python executor window-function support, including ranking, aggregates, frames and exclusions, navigation with IGNORE NULLS, QUALIFY, named windows, grouped windows, subqueries, ordering, and optimized large-window evaluation. Added efficient layout/value caching and compiled expression templates for scale performance.
